arguments.name: TARGET
arguments.description: Control ref returned by observe, or an explicit css= or role= locator for the select control.

commands.usage: act select TARGET --id SESSION (--label LABEL | --value VALUE)
examples: dw-browser act select <CONTROL_REF_FOR_来源> --id <SESSION> --label '完整内容'
commands.guidance: Placeholders in angle brackets must be replaced. First observe the session, read the control's option labels and DOM values, choose exactly one matching field, execute, then observe again. Do not guess values from labels; duplicate matches fail. Copy a selectable choice's select.options[].option unchanged into Action.option; for CLI map its sole label or value field directly to --label or --value, preserving exact strings including empty strings.
